import ratelimiter
from ratelimiter import RateLimiter


def test_invalid_capacity():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RateLimiter(0, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RateLimiter(-3, 1)


def test_invalid_refill():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RateLimiter(5, -0.5)


def test_zero_refill_allowed():
    rl = RateLimiter(2, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(1000) is True
    assert rl.allow(2000) is False


def test_starts_full():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 5.0


def test_tokens_returns_float_when_full():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    assert isinstance(rl.tokens(0), float)


def test_first_call_no_refill_and_sets_reference():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 1)
    assert rl.allow(100, cost=10) is True
    assert rl.tokens(100) == 0.0
    assert rl.tokens(104) == 4.0


def test_allow_consumes_tokens():
    rl = RateLimiter(3, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is False


def test_cost_exactly_available():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=5) is True
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 0.0


def test_cost_exceeds_tokens_takes_nothing():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=6) is False
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 5.0


def test_denied_allow_takes_nothing():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=5) is True
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=1) is False
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 0.0


def test_refill_over_time():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 2)
    rl.allow(0, cost=10)
    assert rl.tokens(1) == 2.0
    assert rl.tokens(3) == 6.0


def test_fractional_refill():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 1)
    rl.allow(0, cost=10)
    assert rl.tokens(0.5) == 0.5
    assert rl.allow(0.5) is False
    assert rl.allow(1.0) is True


def test_refill_capped_at_capacity():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 10)
    rl.allow(0, cost=5)
    assert rl.tokens(1000) == 5.0


def test_denied_allow_still_refills():
    rl = RateLimiter(4, 1)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=4) is True
    assert rl.allow(1, cost=2) is False
    assert rl.tokens(1) == 1.0
    assert rl.tokens(2) == 2.0
    assert rl.allow(2, cost=2) is True


def test_invalid_cost():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(0, cost=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(0, cost=-1)


def test_time_backwards_allow():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    rl.allow(5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(4)


def test_time_backwards_tokens():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    rl.tokens(5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.tokens(4.9)


def test_same_time_ok():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    rl.allow(5)
    assert rl.allow(5) is True
    assert rl.tokens(5) == 3.0


def test_state_valid_after_backwards_error():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 1)
    rl.allow(5, cost=10)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(1)
    assert rl.tokens(7) == 2.0


def test_capacity_one_is_valid():
    rl = RateLimiter(1, 0)
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 1.0
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is False


def test_capacity_one_refills_to_cap():
    rl = RateLimiter(1, 1)
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0.5) is False
    assert rl.allow(1) is True
    assert rl.tokens(100) == 1.0

import datetime
import types

import pytest

import schedule
from schedule import (
    CancelJob,
    IntervalError,
    Job,
    Scheduler,
    ScheduleError,
    ScheduleValueError,
)


class FakeDT(datetime.datetime):
    _now = None

    @classmethod
    def now(cls, tz=None):
        return cls._now


@pytest.fixture
def set_now(monkeypatch):
    fake_mod = types.SimpleNamespace(
        datetime=FakeDT, timedelta=datetime.timedelta, time=datetime.time
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(schedule, "datetime", fake_mod)

    def _set(dt):
        FakeDT._now = dt

    return _set


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clean_default():
    schedule.clear()
    yield
    schedule.clear()


def noop():
    return None


T0 = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 10, 0, 0)  # a Wednesday


def test_every_seconds_next_run(set_now):
    set_now(T0)
    s = Scheduler()
    job = s.every(10).seconds.do(noop)
    assert job.next_run == T0 + datetime.timedelta(seconds=10)


def test_every_default_interval_is_one_unit_later(set_now):
    set_now(T0)
    s = Scheduler()
    assert s.every().day.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 4, 10, 0, 0)
    assert s.every().hour.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 11, 0, 0)
    assert s.every().minute.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 10, 1, 0)
    assert s.every().second.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 10, 0, 1)
    assert s.every().week.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 10, 10, 0, 0)


def test_every_multiple_units(set_now):
    set_now(T0)
    s = Scheduler()
    assert s.every(2).weeks.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 17, 10, 0, 0)
    assert s.every(3).days.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 6, 10, 0, 0)
    assert s.every(5).minutes.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 10, 5, 0)
    assert s.every(2).hours.do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 12, 0, 0)


def test_day_at_before_and_after(set_now):
    s = Scheduler()
    set_now(datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 9, 0, 0))
    assert s.every().day.at("10:30").do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(
        2024, 1, 3, 10, 30, 0
    )
    set_now(datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 11, 0, 0))
    assert s.every().day.at("10:30").do(noop).next_run == datetime.datetime(
        2024, 1, 4, 10, 30, 0
    )


def test_day_at_with_seconds(set_now):
    set_now(datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 9, 0, 0))

    job = s.every().day.at("10:30:15").do(noop)
    assert job.next_run == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 3, 10, 30, 15)


def test_hour_at_minute_only(set_now):

# ---------- UTC offset correction (DST handling) ----------

def _amsterdam_job():
    pytz = pytest.importorskip("pytz")
    s = Scheduler()
    j = s.every().day.at("12:00", "Europe/Amsterdam")
    return pytz.timezone("Europe/Amsterdam"), j


def test_correct_utc_offset_no_change_without_dst_transition():
    tz, j = _amsterdam_job()
    moment = tz.localize(real_dt.datetime(2024, 1, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    result = j._correct_utc_offset(moment + real_dt.timedelta(days=1), True)
    assert result.replace(tzinfo=None) == real_dt.datetime(2024, 1, 11, 12, 0, 0)
    assert result.utcoffset() == real_dt.timedelta(hours=1)


def test_correct_utc_offset_fixates_time_across_dst_start():
    tz, j = _amsterdam_job()
    moment = tz.localize(real_dt.datetime(2024, 3, 30, 12, 0, 0))
    moment = moment + real_dt.timedelta(days=1)
    result = j._correct_utc_offset(moment, True)
    assert result.replace(tzinfo=None) == real_dt.datetime(2024, 3, 31, 12, 0, 0)
    assert result.utcoffset() == real_dt.timedelta(hours=2)


def test_correct_utc_offset_without_fixate_keeps_instant():
    tz, j = _amsterdam_job()
    moment = tz.localize(real_dt.datetime(2024, 3, 30, 12, 0, 0))
    moment = moment + real_dt.timedelta(days=1)
    result = j._correct_utc_offset(moment, False)
    assert result.replace(tzinfo=None) == real_dt.datetime(2024, 3, 31, 13, 0, 0)
    assert result.utcoffset() == real_dt.timedelta(hours=2)


def test_correct_utc_offset_dst_gap_moves_later():
    tz, j = _amsterdam_job()
    moment = tz.localize(real_dt.datetime(2024, 3, 30, 2, 30, 0))
    moment = moment + real_dt.timedelta(days=1)  # 02:30 does not exist
    result = j._correct_utc_offset(moment, True)
    assert result.replace(tzinfo=None) == real_dt.datetime(2024, 3, 31, 3, 30, 0)
    assert result.utcoffset() == real_dt.timedelta(hours=2)

class _TransitionZone:

def _install_fake_pytz(monkeypatch):
    class BaseTzInfo(datetime.tzinfo):
        def utcoffset(self, dt):
            return datetime.timedelta(0)

        def dst(self, dt):
            return datetime.timedelta(0)

        def tzname(self, dt):
            return "FAKE"

    class FakeTz(BaseTzInfo):
        pass

    created = {}

    def timezone(name):
        tz = FakeTz()
        created[name] = tz
        return tz

    """+05 before the transition instant, +06 after it."""

    TRANSITION = real_dt.datetime(2024, 1, 10, 9, 30, tzinfo=real_dt.timezone.utc)

_TRANSITION_UTC = REAL_DT(2024, 3, 10, 7, 0)
_TRANSITION_LOCAL = REAL_DT(2024, 3, 10, 2, 0)


def _install_dst_zone(monkeypatch, now_naive):
    class BaseTzInfo:
        pass

    class Zone(BaseTzInfo):
        def normalize(self, dt):
            u = (dt - dt.utcoffset()).replace(tzinfo=None)
            h = -5 if u < _TRANSITION_UTC else -4
            return (u + datetime.timedelta(hours=h)).replace(tzinfo=_FixedOffset(h))

        def localize(self, naive):
            h = -5 if naive < _TRANSITION_LOCAL else -4
            return naive.replace(tzinfo=_FixedOffset(h))

    mod = types.ModuleType("pytz")
    mod.BaseTzInfo = BaseTzInfo
    mod.timezone = lambda name: Zone()
    monkeypatch.setitem(_sys.modules, "pytz", mod)

    class DstFakeDT(REAL_DT):
        _now = now_naive

        @classmethod
        def now(cls, tz=None):
            if tz is None:
                return cls._now
            return tz.localize(cls._now)

    shim = types.SimpleNamespace(
        datetime=DstFakeDT, timedelta=datetime.timedelta, time=datetime.time
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(schedule, "datetime", shim)
    return Zone()

    assert sleeps == pytest.approx([0.002, 0.004, 0.008])


def test_incrementing_default_increment_end_to_end(sleeps):

    with pytest.raises(IOError):
